card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces of long medical terms such as myelosuppression, rhabdomyolysis and Parkinson, and a few other scattered words. It is strongest on the piece just before the word is completed.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: The marked piece sits inside or at the end of a long clinical word like myelosuppression or Parkinson's.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Unrelated ordinary words in web text, such as citation headings or nouns in lists.
